About Us

Rawalpindi's Most Trusted Interior Specialists

Curtain Hive was founded on a simple idea: to bring high-quality, bespoke interior design to homes and offices in Rawalpindi and Islamabad. Unlike other furniture shops in Rawalpindi, we control the entire process. Our in-house team of designers, craftsmen, and installers ensures that every single detail, from the stitching on your custom curtains to the fit of your 3D wallpaper, is absolutely perfect. We are your local partners, dedicated to quality you can see and feel.

How It Works

Getting the Best Curtains in Rawalpindi is Easy

Book Your Free Measurement Now
  • Free In-Home Consultation
  • Design And Crafting
  • Professional Installation

Our expert will visit your Rawalpindi or Islamabad home, measure your windows, and provide fabric samples—all with no obligation.

 We help you choose the perfect fabric and style. Our local artisans then craft your custom curtains or blinds to your exact specifications.

Our clean, fast, and professional team will install your new window treatments, including any curtain rod holder or motorized blinds tracks, for a flawless finish.
